gravidade.name: Gravity
gravidade.description: All mass pulls on all mass. Whoever manipulates gravity decides which way is down, how much something weighs and what falls toward what.
gravidade.can: Attract and repel bodies, change weight, create local floors, open wormholes.
gravidade.uiBehavior: Elements cluster toward the center. Heavy, tight typography.
gravidade.scale: Infinite, but weak. Grows stronger with mass and proximity.
interactions: Bending space slows time for those nearby.
Compressing matter generates heat.
Only overcomes it at stellar scales, as in the collapse of a star.

forca-forte.name: Strong force
forca-forte.short: Binds what is close. Unbreakable up close.
forca-forte.description: The force that holds the nucleus together. At extremely short range nothing defeats it; one step further, it vanishes.
forca-forte.can: Fuse, make indestructible, keep something from coming apart. Breaking the bond releases brutal energy.
forca-forte.uiBehavior: Elements stick to one another and become a single block. Bold typography, no breathing room.
interactions: One holds the nucleus together; the other unravels it from within.
Breaking a strong bond is the greatest source of energy there is.

forca-fraca.name: Weak force
forca-fraca.description: The force of transformation: it changes the identity of particles and makes unstable matter decay, little by little.
forca-fraca.can: Transmute materials, speed up or slow down decay, make something unstable.
forca-fraca.uiBehavior: Each element changes shape and fades in sequence. Light typography.
forca-fraca.scale: Extremely short, slow and cumulative effect.
interactions: Undoes what the strong force binds.
All decay is irreversible and increases disorder.

entropia.name: Entropy
entropia.description: The tendency of everything to spread out and mix. Manipulating it means hastening ruin or, with great effort, restoring order to something.
entropia.can: Age, corrode, disperse heat and attention; or reorganize what has come undone.
entropia.uiBehavior: Elements scatter at random angles. Spaced-out, misaligned typography.
interactions: Gives time its direction: the past is the most ordered.
To remember is to resist disorder.
Together they decide what happens on its own.

entalpia.name: Enthalpy
entalpia.description: The energy contained in something, ready to come out as heat. Whoever manipulates it heats, freezes, melts or detonates.
entalpia.can: Burn, freeze, melt, explode, extract energy from reactions.
entalpia.uiBehavior: Elements glow and rise like a flame. Typography with a warm halo.
entalpia.scale: Medium. Proportional to the matter involved.
interactions: Together they define free energy: what can happen spontaneously.
Gravitational compression heats things up.

tempo.name: Time
tempo.description: The sequence of everything. Manipulating time means stretching or compressing instants and, in extreme cases, seeing echoes of what once was.
tempo.can: Speed up or slow down a body, freeze an instant, see echoes of the recent past.
tempo.uiBehavior: Elements leave trails and echoes. Typography with repeated shadows.
interactions: Mass slows time around it.
Without growing disorder, there would be no before and after.
Memory is time stored in someone.

alma.name: Soul
alma.short: Threads that bind beings to one another.
alma.description: The force that animates living beings. Its users weave threads as fine as spider silk, glowing with their own light, that link the souls of people and animals.
alma.can: Bond with animals and see through their eyes, nourish the body, control the environment, lift people by threads. In Silence Penascle, redirect madness onto another person.
alma.uiBehavior: One element gains an aura and a pale thread runs through them all. Italic typography with a soft glow.
alma.scale: Visible wherever magic is concentrated; the threads link those who are connected.
interactions: During the transition, the threads bring to the surface the dead the initiate carries.
Draining the souls of others prolongs the life of the one who drains.
The erosion of will is disorder of the soul.

memorias.name: Memories
memorias.short: Reads, records and erases what was lived.
memorias.description: The record of what has been lived, in people and perhaps in places. Manipulating it means reading, implanting or erasing memories.
memorias.can: Read memories, erase them, implant false memories, see an object's past.
memorias.uiBehavior: Elements with dashed outlines; some vanish and leave gaps. Italic typography.
interactions: Without memory, the soul does not recognize itself.
Each memory is a piece of stored time.
Forgetting is entropy at work in the mind.
